svg.text: Wrote the portable Kafka Streams runner, so pipelines from any Beam SDK run
on Kafka Streams. Ships in the nightly snapshots.
The community platform. Careers, projects and testimonials pages, and a
Custom OAuth providers end to end, then carried into the JS, Swift and Kotlin
Added the Mistral, Cerebras, DeepSeek and Perplexity providers to the MCP
Built the i18n notification toast. Tree-shaking in Vite made the bundle 30%
Fixed user creation in the FAB auth manager. E2E tests for Asset Details.
UI and auth overhauls across the mobile app and the web client.
Custom base URLs through env vars, and stricter audio MIME checks.
Merged two property utils into one module. Config coverage for Electron.
Won their PR hackathon with an incremental Gmail connector.
Timer duration bucket parsing in the metrics init.
Mainline on ARM64, patches sent the old way with git send-email.
